item: The vLLM status probe never contacts an address on another computer: a non-loopback OO_VLLM_URL is refused by the shared loopback rule before any lookup or connect, and Settings says why
summary: port_occupant() ran on every GET /api/llm/vllm/status (no click), swallowed VllmClient's loopback refusal and then connect_ex'd the OO_VLLM_URL host. Now _loopback_refusal (the rule _require_loopback raises) answers first: state refused with the reason, nothing resolved or connected; start() refuses before clearing the GPU or spawning; a malformed port reads unknown; an empty setting means the default. Survey of other no-click probes: no second instance. Release line: The local-AI status check no longer contacts a vLLM address on another computer; Settings says why it was refused.
